name: valorbrain
description: Durable memory for Codex: context at session start and with every prompt, a memory checkpoint every few turns, and the ValorBrain MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Durable memory for your Codex sessions
interface.longDescription: Every Codex session starts with what ValorBrain knows about the work, each prompt brings the relevant memory along, and every few turns Codex is asked to record what is worth keeping. The hooks run the official ValorBrain client (@valorbrain/connect); the ValorBrain MCP server gives Codex the memory tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $valorbrain:status to show whether ValorBrain is connected
Use $valorbrain:setup to sign this machine in to ValorBrain
